title: Live Update 1.36.0
body:
# Live Update 1.36.0

Raiders!

Your tentative alliance with the Nomads keeps growing stronger. Nomads roam the streets of Speranza, offering stories, useful information, and loot to trade. With the ARC presence Topside continuing to expand, having dependable allies matters more than ever.

Update 1.36.0 has arrived, bringing bug fixes, quality-of-life improvements, matchmaking adjustments, a new Expedition and Trials Season, and a crossover outfit tied to the virtual gameshow world of THE FINALS!

# **What's New?**

* Expedition 4 - Zenith Outfit

* Trials Season 5 - Scorta Outfit

* Solo, Duo, and Trio Matchmaking

* ARC Raiders & THE FINALS Crossover

* Store Update - The Triumph Set

* Store Redesign

## **Solo, Duo, and Trio Matchmaking**

Based on the feedback gathered from the Matchmaking survey shared in May, we've rolled out one of the most requested matchmaking changes: **your playstyle is now tracked separately for Solo, Duo, and Trio rounds, and matches are made accordingly.**

For example, imagine you play cooperatively when solo, but your two squadmates prefer aggressive PvP in trios. Previously, playing friendly solo could nudge you toward more cooperative trio matches, and playing PvP-heavy in trios could push your solo matches toward more PvP-focused opponents too - meaning matchmaking needed time to catch up whenever you switched squad size.

That overlap is now gone. You can move between calm questing and gathering in Solo rounds and intense PvP action in Trio rounds (assuming that's your usual pattern in each), just by adjusting your squad size. Duo rounds work the same way - all three squad sizes are tracked independently.

## **ARC Raiders & THE FINALS Crossover**

By finishing a set of Contracts in THE FINALS, you can unlock the Azimuth outfit and the Archeologist backpack bundle in ARC Raiders. The set draws inspiration from explorers, Raiders, and Contestants willing to chase new horizons beyond the stratosphere.

This promotion runs from July 9th at 3pm CEST through July 30th at 3pm CEST. After that, the direction reverses, letting players earn the Azimuth bundle in THE FINALS by playing ARC Raiders instead.

See you in the Arena... and The Rust Belt!

# **Bug Fixes & Content Updates**

**ARC**

* The amount of loot dropped by ARC Turbines has been significantly increased.

* **Dev note:** We heard your feedback that ARC Turbine loot felt too low given the effort needed to destroy one, and we agree. That's why we've substantially boosted the loot the ARC Turbine drops. Happy hunting!

* Fixed a bug where the ARC Turbine could vanish shortly after spawning.

* Knockback from Queen and Matriarch stomps can no longer pass through walls.

**Cosmetic**

* Fixed a clipping problem affecting the Marco Outfit.

* Fixed a bug where the Bog Walker Set was missing its new color variants.

* Over the coming days, refunds will be issued to players who spent extra Raider Tokens to unlock these new colors. This process should happen automatically and requires no action from you.

**Items**

* Weapons lying on the ground now show their installed mods.

* ARC Turbine parts no longer drop from Couriers.

* Higher-value items now appear on the shelf in the Raider Den, even when large stacks of lower-value items add up to a greater total value than a single higher-value item.

**Maps**

* Fixed multiple spots where players could get stuck or clip through terrain.

* Fixed several locations near spawn bunkers on The Dam where players could fall through the terrain.

**Quests**

* Fixed a bug where the Quests tab could loop back to the 'Done' screen after claiming a reward and pressing ESC, blocking selection of a new quest.

**Social**

* The Emote Wheel now refreshes availability while it's open, making it clearer which emotes can currently be used.

**UI**

* Fixed several German localization issues.

* Improved the Feeding Rewards section in the Scrappy Nest by removing an empty placeholder tile and clarifying the messaging shown when no rewards are available or still pending.

* Fixed a bug where the HUD visibility setting wasn't being applied correctly at the start of a round.

* Fixed a bug where the Show/Hide Tooltip option for controllers in the Logbook stopped working after collapsing and expanding a quest entry.

# **Known Issues**

* Some PC players may notice lower FPS than usual.

* While this is being investigated, make sure your GPU drivers are up to date. If the problem persists, try rolling back to a previous driver version.

* An ongoing issue is being investigated where some XBOX players, particularly on Series S, experience crashes.

* The Quick Wheel item selection may unexpectedly switch to a different item when the Wheel is closed and reopened quickly.

* The Dolabra, Hullcracker, and Rascal do not deal damage to training dummies on the Practice Range.

* The throw animation may sometimes fail to appear when trying to detonate a Trigger 'Nade right after throwing it.

* Some gadgets and throwables are missing a "Cancel" button when preparing to throw them.

* The weapon swap animation may look broken if you swap weapons immediately after vaulting.

* Player animations may appear broken when a search of the Baron Husk is interrupted.

* Shredders float to the ceiling in some rooms of the Hidden Bunker.

* Leapers are able to jump through the ARC Turbine.

* The Access Capacitor Rack occasionally spawns without interactable batteries.

* The pickup sound played when collecting items is sometimes incorrect.

* Items that grant Merits incorrectly display a Merits icon when brought into a Raid.

* Shots fired while riding ARC may sometimes fail to register.

* After a player is revived, some Augments' health restoration effects no longer pause correctly when the player takes damage.

* Some doors let player flashlight beams pass through instead of blocking the light.

* Some hairstyles may clip through the Reaver Outfit helmet.

* The Saltwalker outfit preview on the Forgotten Relics page may incorrectly show two toggles per element.

* Clipping issues have been noticed with the Triumph and Azimuth outfits, and this is being looked into.

* Old Ermal offers may appear available in the 'Acquire and Craft' menu, though this is visual only.

# **Maintaining Fair Play**

Topside can be dangerous and unpredictable, which is part of its appeal, but nobody enjoys running into Raiders who've found ways to gain unfair advantages.

Since the May update on Ensuring Fair Play, regular updates have been shared on the progress made against players seeking unfair advantages. This section recaps everything done so far and adds some further detail.

## Anti-Cheat and Detection

Over the past few weeks, the rollout of Denuvo Anti-Cheat has been completed. It is now enforced for every player, and results so far have been encouraging.

Thanks to the anti-cheat team's work, identifying and acting against cheaters is becoming steadily more effective.

These gains come from ongoing refinements to the anti-cheat systems, including hardware and software detection, machine-learning-driven analysis of input telemetry, and more.

## Handling & Preventing Item Duplication

As with anti-cheat, work against duplication exploits never stops. The game economy is closely monitored, with exploits continually catalogued, investigated, and countered.

Recently, several duplication-related exploits have been fixed. Because it's important that fixes are broadly effective, results are monitored and evaluated before progress is shared publicly.

## Evolving "No Free Loadouts"

Encountering Raiders with free kits during a high-value map condition can feel unfair. Since update 1.33.0, the experimental "No Free Loadout" requirement has been applied to Night Raid and Close Scrutiny. Player reactions have been noted, and this feedback is being factored into future plans.

Expanding "No Free Loadout" to additional map conditions is under consideration, alongside other ways to improve the overall experience. The feedback shared in last week's survey is appreciated, and updates will follow once new changes are ready to test.

## What's Next?

There is still more work ahead. Progress on all of these initiatives will continue to be shared whenever possible. As you may have noticed, you now receive an in-game Action Notice when action has been taken against someone you reported. Compensation also continues for loot lost to cheaters, whether or not you reported them - these are two separate parts of the same overall system. Progress updates will keep coming, and thank you for continuing to report and inform on unlawful behavior.

See you Topside, //Ossen and The ARC Raiders Team
